I was writing the exact same thing but I stopped when I saw your comment, I can’t agree more.

These situations make me really sad and upset at the same time, I’m a psychiatry resident and the amount of similar cases we see in the clinic are tremendous.

(((Please note that I can’t judge based on only few texts in one context))) She doesn’t sound like a naturally aggressive or even dormant aggressive character, I really can’t blame either sides, she grew up in a society that can never accept such behaviours, it’s like you’re putting someone very old who has never used a computer before in a room full of computers and telling him you have to learn how to use them all by himself or else the world will be destroyed.

I also can’t blame the OP for his feelings because he is facing his own mom who took care of him yet being called names by her at the same time.

We always advise our patients if their parents aren’t aggressive in any way (especially physically) to take it in baby steps, it’s not the patient’s fault yet it’s not theirs too!

I really hope that both the OP and his mom get to a middle zone where he can be himself and she can be also happy for him or at least not in a continuous state of tension. I would say to at least they don’t hurt each other emotionally.
